capabilities: Render wavejson code blocks as timing diagrams
Edit diagram source in place with a pencil and checkmark toolbar
Click waveform cells to change signal values
Zoom and scale the diagram to the block width
Show parser error messages under broken blocks
disambiguation: Not a JSON formatter or editor; it renders WaveJSON timing diagrams and edits their source.
extras: Not yet in the community plugin list, so it must be installed through BRAT or manually. The vault file is written only when editing ends, and the editing area has a fixed height of min(72vh, 560px).
problem: Timing diagrams normally have to be built or edited in a separate tool, so the diagram source and the note drift apart.

relations.evidence: Renders like the original. Same arrow shapes, group brackets, phase shifts and data labels as WaveDrom.

summary: Renders WaveJSON timing diagrams from fenced code blocks in reading view and lets you edit the waveform in place.
